title: Lie On Resume #resume
description:
The job market is a language game.

Let’s talk about your resume—specifically, job titles.

Sometimes, it feels like companies hand out titles like “Member Delight Director” or “Happiness Coordinator.” But at the end of the day, these are customer support roles.

Recruiters aren’t searching for “Happiness Coordinator” on LinkedIn. They’re searching for industry-standard terms.

Here’s my advice: normalize your titles.

On your resume, make them clear and recognizable to the hiring market. 

If you’re uneasy about this, you can always include the original title in parentheses:
 Customer Support Manager (Happiness Coordinator)

The bottom line is this: adapt to the market; don’t wait for the market to adapt to you.

And if you’re job hunting, tools like the Teal Resume Builder can help ensure your resume speaks the right language to get you noticed.
